title: Woman Acts Like An 'Entitled' Brat After Leaving Scene Of Brutal Crash
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 5th, 2023. Officers responded to the scene of a car crash. The suspect immediately fled the scene. When the officers tracked the suspect down, she was beyond rude and refused to take accountability for her actions. She kept saying she had no car insurance and that her baby daddy was behind on child support and she couldn't afford it. She also had a suspended license .This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
